title: DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, October 9, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, October 9, 2018 Posted by admin on October 9th, (PFE). 77 points.
Monday the Dow was up +39.73 (+0.15%) at 26,486.78.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +7.15%.
There were 19 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Walgreens (WBA) +2.26% and Walmart (WMT) +1.48%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Visa (V) -2.39% and Cisco (CSCO) -1.27%.
Apple (AAPL -0.23%) was rated a new ‘Sell’ at Vertical Group with a price target of $175.
Merk & Co (MRK +0.61%) was rated a new ‘Buy’ $84.
